info.title: Zenon P2P Observer
info.description: Read-only collection and relay-association API. See api.md and association-analysis.md. Producer software versions remain null. Raw windows: at most 24 hours within raw retention. Associations: complete UTC hours, default seven days, up to 90 days within aggregate retention. GET/HEAD/OPTIONS only; bodies rejected; 1 MiB response limit. Collections cache 30 seconds with ETags.
